name: Malé · Maldives
tagline: Turquoise atolls, coral reefs and overwater villas
summary: The Maldives is a nation of 1,190 coral islands in 26 atolls, famous for turquoise lagoons, house reefs, manta rays and overwater villas. Fly into Malé, then reach resorts or local islands by speedboat or seaplane.
seasonNote: December to April is the dry northeast monsoon. May to November is wetter but good for mantas and whale sharks in some atolls.
arrival: Velana International Airport is on its own island next to Malé.
gettingAround: Speedboats, seaplanes and public ferries; resorts arrange transfers.
cashTip: Resorts bill in US dollars to your room; carry some USD or rufiyaa for local islands and tips.
foodTip: Mas huni tuna breakfast, garudhiya fish soup and hedhikaa snacks.
buyTip: Lacquer work, mats and local tuna products.
baseArea: A resort, or Maafushi for a budget local island
